This WebView supports browser WebAuthn. Regular pages can request passkeys.
Android has not granted website-origin access. Passkeys are disabled; system autofill remains available.
This WebView does not expose browser WebAuthn. Update Android System WebView to check newer support.

Passkey login also requires a compatible, trusted credential provider. Google Password Manager requires approval for third-party browsers; enabling this WebView capability alone does not grant access.
Fullscreen video in picture in picture
Press Home while a regular fullscreen video is playing. You can also use the fullscreen picture-in-picture button.

Off by default. When enabled, the current regular page can keep playing with system media controls. Switching tabs, headphones disconnecting or losing audio focus pauses playback. Private pages always pause when hidden.
